purpose: Teach: 信条/造成/受理/一元化/大前提/証書/共用/黙々と

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の信条、若いうちに、確立しろ、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — establish your research creed while you're young. I'm serious about this. Absolutely.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Opens with the name like a wake-up call. Slight emphasis on 「確立しろ」 — not harsh, but unmissable. Warm underneath the firmness. Repeats the core phrase with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマの申請、教授会で、受理、いただきました、本当に、嬉しいです、宅地造成にも、関わる、テーマです。
lines.en: Yes. My research proposal was approved by the faculty committee, and I'm genuinely grateful. It's a theme that connects to land development.
lines.style: Respectful but gaining confidence. Slight breathiness on the opening — the careful politeness of the younger speaker. Picks up momentum when talking about the theme itself, showing real engagement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究データ、一元化、進めろ、研究効率、絶対、上がるからな、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Unify your research data and move forward with it. It will absolutely increase your research efficiency. I'm telling you.
lines.style: Clipped, directive tone. Each phrase lands with purpose — this is practical instruction, not suggestion. Steady eye contact. The confidence of someone who has seen this work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説の検証、大前提として、慎重に、進めてまいります、絶対、本気、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I'll proceed carefully with hypothesis verification as a foundational step. I'm committed to this.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Respectful but not deferential — this is his commitment, stated plainly. Slight pause before each key phrase, like he's choosing his words carefully. Trails off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文掲載証書、君も、いつか、手に、することになるぞ、本当に、頑張れ、絶対。
lines.en: One day, you'll hold a published paper with your name on it. Keep working hard. Absolutely.
lines.style: Shift to something warmer — still authoritative, but now reaching forward. 「手に」gets a softer touch. The final repetition of 「絶対」 is almost affectionate — a steady conviction in his student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室、共用スペース、研究者、皆、配慮しております、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I'm being considerate of the shared lab space and all the researchers working there. Truly.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath the politeness. He's stating a fact about himself — not seeking credit, just confirming he understands responsibility. Steady, unrushed. Slight warmth in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、黙々と、研究、続けてる姿、評価してるぞ、絶対、本気で、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Ren, I see you working quietly on your research day after day. I want you to know I respect that. Keep going. Absolutely.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaks through the formality. Opens with the name again — softer this time. Slows down on 「黙々と」 as if seeing him in that moment. The closing repetition is almost fatherly — not demanding, affirming.
